subject: Malaysia TiO2 — an additional supply option for Bailey
body:
For Bailey's own paint ranges, evaluating an additional TiO2 source means checking performance against your existing product requirements.

I'm Ai Long with IKHLAS, a titanium dioxide manufacturer in Malaysia. We offer M-510 for coatings, with technical documentation and samples to help your team assess it before a purchasing decision. This gives Bailey another supply option to evaluate in its own formulations.

May I send you the M510 TDS and our REACH documentation so your team can decide whether to evaluate a sample?
